content: Wikipedia data. BIBREF9's `Conversations Gone Awry' dataset consists of 1,270 conversations that took place between Wikipedia editors on publicly accessible talk pages. The conversations are sourced from the WikiConv dataset BIBREF59 and labeled by crowdworkers as either containing a personal attack from within (i.e., hostile behavior by one user in the conversation directed towards another) or remaining civil throughout.
